facts.text: Snow left Fish Creek (7,700 ft) and Silvies (7,000 ft) 30 to 42 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Fish Creek
evidence.detail: left May 9; earlier seasons: June 7 (2023), June 8 (2024), June 9 (2025)

evidence.name: Silvies
evidence.detail: left April 4; earlier seasons: May 19 (2023), May 16 (2024), May 10 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Fish Creek (7,700 ft) and Silvies (7,000 ft).

evidence.name: Fish Creek
evidence.detail: 10.0 in on April 17; earlier seasons: 35.6 in (2023), 45.9 in (2024), 54.6 in (2025)

evidence.name: Silvies
evidence.detail: 0.6 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 21.0 in (2023), 19.2 in (2024), 24.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 10 and May 5, carried from the melt-out dates at Fish Creek (7,700 ft) and Silvies (7,000 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Fish Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 9, 1,161 ft above the pass; points to March 19 to May 19

evidence.name: Silvies
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, 461 ft above the pass; points to March 2 to April 21
